title: The US Border Crossing With No Officers #shorts
summary: At the Northwest Angle there are no border officers: travellers report to US Customs on the CBP ROAM app or a kiosk, and phone Canada's border agency before driving back through Manitoba.
sources: US Census Bureau, 2020 Census via TIGERweb: Angle township, Lake of the Woods County, MN: population 149, housing units 335, land 323,165,247 m2, water 1,233,153,221 m2 (water = 79% of the area): https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Census2020/MapServer/20/query?where=GEOID%3D%272707701550%27&outFields=NAME,GEOID,POP100,HU100,AREALAND,AREAWATER&returnGeometry=false&f=json

Lake of the Woods Tourism, Helpful info when driving up to the NW Angle: three CBP kiosks (Jim's Corner, the NW Angle school, Young's Bay); before driving back through Canada call the CBSA from the phone at Jim's Corner, receive a number to write down and keep it in case you are checked: https://lakeofthewoodsmn.com/?p=17678
Lake of the Woods Tourism, Border information: 'The Northwest Angle has been granted a special use to use the App on smart phones' (CBP ROAM): https://lakeofthewoodsmn.com/border-information

US Customs and Border Protection, CBP Introduces a New Application for Small Boat Reporting in the Great Lakes: ROAM = Reporting Offsite Arrival - Mobile; 'The CBPO may initiate a video chat to further interview travelers': https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/local-media-release/new-small-boat-reporting-procedures-now-effect-0

Canada Border Services Agency, news release 10 Aug 2026: from 1 Dec 2026 travellers in remote areas report at a port of entry or a designated telephone reporting site; areas include the Northwest Angle Area: https://www.canada.ca/en/border-services-agency/news/2026/08/update-permits-extended-until-november-30-2026-cbsa-to-enhance-border-integrity-and-expand-telephone-reporting-in-remote-border-areas.html

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain) https://www.naturalearthdata.com and US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files (public domain) https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/time-series/geo/carto-boundary-file.html; drive and boat routes are drawn schematically

scenes.narration: At the Northwest Angle, you check in with US Customs on the {CBP ROAM|C.B.P. Roam} app. An officer may video-call you.

data.source: CBP; Lake of the Woods Tourism

scenes.narration: Heading back out through Canada, you phone Canada's border agency from a booth, and write down the number.

data.source: Lake of the Woods Tourism; CBSA

scenes.narration: Angle Township: {149|a hundred and forty-nine} people in {2020|twenty twenty}.
No officers on site. At this border, you report yourself.
